summary: The raw model matches the approved concept part for part, is within budget, and every color assertion passes; only minor detached parts and non-manifold edges remain.

findings.observation: Besides the 4,713-triangle body, the mesh has four small detached parts (two 50-triangle pieces about 6.8 x 2.9 x 1.4 cm, plus 42- and 38-triangle pieces about 2 to 2.5 cm across). From their size and symmetry they are most likely facial features or buckle pieces, not stray fragments, and none of them is visible as floating geometry in any view.
There are 13 non-manifold edges and 2 open boundary loops (the limit is 10). They are not visible at render distance.
The mouth barely shows on the face. The art bible already covers this with a texture overlay applied at clean time.

questions_answered: Present: spiky dark hair, teal high-collar tunic flaring to the knee with a front split, leather vest with front X-straps, waist belt, iron-grey wrist bracers, dark trousers, knee-high leather boots with turned cuffs, empty hands with fingers. On the back, the vest has a plain panel with horizontal waist straps and no X, which matches the accepted multiview change. Nothing is absent. The only change is a fainter mouth, which the overlay handles.

No spikes, fused limbs or extra props are visible. There are 2 holes (within the limit of 10) and 13 non-manifold edges. The 4 small separate parts are likely eyes or buckle pieces rather than floating fragments (minor).
Yes: 4,893 triangles against a budget of 5,500, one 256x256 albedo, and a height of 1.8 m against the 1.8 m target.

All color assertions pass. The five concept colors checked are kept and matched after correction (delta ab 1.3 or less). No large area is in an unrequested color. The three skipped clusters are each under 3% of the concept.
